Select IC50 activity records for dapagliflozin (CHEMBL429910) and its salt forms against sodium/glucose cotransporter 2 (CHEMBL3884). Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from the parent molregno. Retrieve activity provenance via the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50' and target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3884'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate; preserve all activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
